value: MPSCring: every durable write of the box handed from its submitters to the one writer

The bounded multi-producer single-consumer ring of pointers kyr_core's write queue carries each write job through, from any request thread to the one writer thread of its environment. ECSS-E-ST-40C Rev.1 and ECSS-Q-ST-80C Rev.2, category B proposed; the requirements baseline is KYR's (the platform), the release qualified is 1.0.10.
